name: pipit
description: A quiet PDF workspace with keyboard navigation and reference portals

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:assets && npm run build:core && vite --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: npm run prepare:assets && npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-extensions.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/test-core.mjs && node scripts/verification/research-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/text-lines-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/color-palette-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/color-queue-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/shortcuts-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/platform-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/field-preview-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/notebook-sidecar-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/tutor-unit.mjs
scripts.test:site: node scripts/verification/site-unit.mjs && node scripts/verification/site-build.mjs && node scripts/verification/docs-build.mjs && node scripts/verification/public-copy-audit.mjs
scripts.verify:alpha: npm test && npm run build && npm run package && node scripts/verification/extension-packages.mjs && npm run build:site && npm run test:site
